captions.content: We always love stumbling across fun little comics like this! The methodology here is absolutely spot-on. Forcing a subject to hold a punishing, trembling tiptoe stance just to avoid the intense shock of those mini cattle prods under her heels is a flawless demonstration of posture enforcement. It’s such a beautifully simple, highly effective concept that we’re seriously considering slipping this illustration directly into our junior handler training materials. A little visual inspiration never hurts!
How unfortunate that they didn't wire her nipples into the circuit. That big booty is making it tough for her to stay on her tippy-toes.

comments.text: The way the knot changes the angle of the hook from the inside is nice attention to detail by the animator.
